fusions.name: Gnawing Mites
fusions.desc: Looses 4 mites spread apart, each dealing 2 damage. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Sundered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gorging Bite
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 26 damage, always strikes critically, makes the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds and leaves it [Diseased] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Feeding Cloud
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to raise a cloud of reef mites for 16 seconds that bites an enemy within 5 tiles for 2 damage every 0.8 seconds. Each kill you make while it is out restores 3 health.

fusions.name: Stored Meal
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you are healed for 3% of your maximum health per stack (15% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
